meaning:
A man of the Moabites living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.22.2;
father of: Balak (H1111)
§ Zippor = "sparrow"
father of Balak the king of Moab at the time of the exodus

elsewhere.note: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
